scripts.check: bun run build:packages && bun run lint && tsgo --noEmit && bun run check:react && bun run check:i18n && bun run check:packages && bun run check:deps && bun run check:audit && bun run check:secrets && bun run check:monorepo && bun run check:arch && bun run test:type-shapes && bun run test:tools && bun run test:dupes
scripts.test:unit:quick: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all); bun test "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:unit:heavy: bash -lc 'mapfile -t test_files < <(bun tools/unit-tests/src/list.ts all --heavy-only); bun test --timeout 180000 "${test_files[@]}"'
scripts.test:dupes: jscpd packages/scene-graph/src packages/pen/src packages/core/src packages/cli/src packages/dom-css/src src --min-lines 5 --min-tokens 50 --format typescript --threshold 0
scripts.test:packages: bun tools/package-quality/src/check/metadata.ts && bun tools/package-quality/src/check/publint.ts && bun tools/package-quality/src/check/attw.ts && bun tools/package-quality/src/smoke.ts
